subject: English
stimulus: (a) If you are up and doing in studies ⎯⎯. (b) Read attentively lest ⎯⎯. (c) Failing in the examination ⎯⎯. (d) So, it is high time for you ⎯⎯. (e) ⎯⎯ that a stitch in time saves nine.
guide_solution: (a) If you are up and doing in studies you can make a good result. (b) Read attentively lest you should fail in the exam. (c) Failing in the examination is not expected. (d) So, it is high time for you to study attentively. (e) A proverb goes that a stitch in time saves nine.
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Dinajpur Board-2024 (Made Easy BQ 2nd)
